extracted_concepts.name: Fraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number representing part of a whole, with a numerator and denominator.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interpreting a fraction as division of the numerator by the denominator.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Multiplying a fraction or whole number by a fraction.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dividing fractions by fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Measurement unit conversion
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Converting among different-sized standard measurement units.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The amount of space occupied by a three-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate plane
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A plane used to graph points using coordinates.

extracted_concepts.name: Graphing points
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Graphing points on the coordinate plane.

extracted_concepts.name: Two-dimensional figures
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Plane shapes classified based on their properties.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sorting two-dimensional figures into categories based on properties.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio reasoning
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Using ratio relationships to solve problems.

extracted_concepts.name: Unit rate
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rate associated with a ratio, often expressed per one unit.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimal
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A base-ten representation of a number using tenths, hundredths, and beyond.

extracted_concepts.name: Greatest common factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The largest factor shared by two or more numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Least common multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The smallest multiple shared by two or more numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical phrase containing numbers, operations, and possibly variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Variable
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A symbol used to represent a value in an expression or equation.

extracted_concepts.name: Evaluating expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding the value of an expression at specific values of its variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expressions that have the same value for all allowed values of their variables.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement that two expressions are equal.

extracted_concepts.name: Solving equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding the value or values that make an equation true.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The amount of surface covered by a two-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Triangle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A polygon with three sides and three angles.

extracted_concepts.name: Trapezoid
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quadrilateral with at least one pair of parallel sides.

extracted_concepts.name: Polygon
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A closed two-dimensional figure made of line segments.

extracted_concepts.name: Right rectangular prism
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A three-dimensional figure with rectangular faces and right angles.

extracted_concepts.name: Net
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A two-dimensional representation of the faces of a three-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A question that anticipates variability in data.

extracted_concepts.name: Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The pattern of values in a data set.

extracted_concepts.name: Measure of center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A value that describes the center of a data distribution.

extracted_concepts.name: Measure of variation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A value that describes the spread of a data distribution.
